explanation: Only fires at D1 in late-episode trials (about trial 75 onward), during a run of consecutive unrewarded trials: it is 0 for the first one or two losses, about 6 at the next loss D1, and about 9-10 at the one after, then drops back to 0 at the following D1 (usually when the agent switches choice). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, after any rewarded trial, and at all D1 steps before trial ~75, even during loss streaks.
